notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only dated mention is the 1939 field examination behind the Pastmaps map of the Cassian sheet, which is a secondary summary of the map, not the map itself. The Central US Lookouts page gives only the county. The gone status comes from the FFLA list. No build date, staffing, or site description was found in the six page reads and two searches. The WPR figures are statewide, not specific to this tower, and the story now says so by writing about the state's towers.
